summary: For a sound in a room next to the listener's room: which neighbouring room, through which portal and where the portal is. Written by ecl::sound::RoomSystem (macOS: IsInNeighborRoom / GetPortalPosition), read by ls::SoundTransformSystem and ls::SoundOcclusionSystem (sound positioned at the portal).

fields.name: Room
fields.evidence: bg3.exe+0x1DB5A80 (component add, AllocRaw 0x20) copies *param_3 to +0; caller bg3.exe+0x1DB4200 passes local_280 = *(room object + 0x70) (an entity of the room) or the null handle. Live: entity handles.

fields.name: Portal
fields.evidence: +8 = *param_4, filled by bg3.exe+0x1DAF910 (nearest portal search: loops over 0x20-byte portal records, keeps the alive entity with the smallest squared distance, default null). Live: entity handles / null.

fields.name: PortalPosition
fields.evidence: +0x10..+0x1B = the 12-byte position from bg3.exe+0x1DAF910 (portal transform +0x10..+0x18), default (FLT_MAX, FLT_MAX, FLT_MAX). Live: world coordinates and 3.403e+38.

fields.name: field_1C
fields.evidence: +0x1C = *param_6 (one byte) from the caller. Live: low byte 0/1.

open_questions: Whether +0 is the neighbouring room or the sound's own room (taken from a room object's +0x70).
